page.t: Right-click one or more stations on the map - yours or another faction's - and choose Supply Chain to create one or add to an existing one.
Name the new supply chain. %s %s will be added to it.
stock coverage at full operation without deliveries:
time to full at full operation without collections:
Mutual trade: %s link(s) drawn one way only (%s)
No stock coverage or capacity warning at full operation.
Those stations were already in this supply chain.
%s stations could not be found and are not shown.
%s station could not be found and is not shown.
%s station(s) have unavailable storage information. Links remain visible; unavailable amounts show as ?.
At full operation: %s consumed, including current workforce. Assumes sufficient inputs and output space.
At full operation: %s produced, including current production modifiers. Assumes sufficient inputs and output space.
Maximum hourly rate unknown: unmeasured mining/trading, shipbuilding demand, or unavailable module data.
This station has no input or output wares under the chain's rules.
Capacity is an estimate: the station's total storage for this transport type, shared with other wares.
Maximum supply is incomplete or unknown; no complete balance is available.
Maximum demand is incomplete or unknown; no complete balance is available.
Lowest known stock coverage at full operation, without deliveries: %s, %s
Balanced: maximum supply equals maximum demand
At full operation: production %s, consumption %s, balance %s. Includes current workforce consumption; excludes mining deliveries and trades.
Combined stock or storage capacity is incomplete; the fill bar is unavailable. Known subtotals are shown with ?.
Combined current stock / storage allocation across suppliers and consumers, counting each station once. Reservations are not added to current stock.
Combined maximum hourly production at supplier stations, with current production modifiers and sufficient inputs and output space. Excludes mining deliveries and trades.
Combined maximum hourly consumption at consumer stations, including current workforce consumption, with sufficient inputs and output space. Excludes trade orders.
The total is incomplete. Any displayed number is the known subtotal; ? marks additional unmeasured contributions.
Maximum consumption is zero; supply/demand ratio is not applicable.
Reserved trades unavailable; expected fill is unknown.
Chain structure changed. Reopen this view to rebuild.
Some stations could not be refreshed. Retrying automatically.

Current stock / full storage, expressed as hours of maximum consumption including current workforce. Assumes no deliveries; reservations are not included. The second value describes the buffer when fully stocked.

Current stock / full storage, expressed as hours of maximum production. For an output this is production-equivalent inventory, not consumer coverage or time remaining until full. Reservations and collections are not included.
Orange bar segment: maximum supply is below maximum demand by %s.
Red stock number: maximum demand exceeds maximum supply beyond the balance tolerance. This colour describes production balance, not current inventory movement.
This chain needs %s nodes and %s edges; the game's diagram supports at most %s and %s. Common wares were collapsed and these stations were left out: %s
Split this chain into smaller ones to see it.
No trade links between these stations
A link needs one station with a sell offer for a ware and another with a buy offer for the same ware. Wares a station both produces and consumes internally do not count.
Delete supply chain "%s"? The stations themselves will not be affected.
